qa.question: Should the majority owner be Elm Road Generating Station Supercritical LLC?
qa.finding: The application says the units are majority-owned by Elm Road Generating Station Supercritical, LLC, with MGE and WPPI at 8.33% each. The WEC Energy Group 2025 annual report says its We Power subsidiary owns the rest and leases it to Wisconsin Electric, so Wisconsin Electric is the lessee and operator.
qa.recommendation: Change the 83% owner from Wisconsin Electric Power Co to Elm Road Generating Station Supercritical LLC, and name We Power as its parent if the entity list has it.
qa.note: Open https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=566031 and read section 6.2.1, Previous and Current Land Use and Ownership. In the WEC Energy Group 2025 annual report at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/783325/000078332526000018/wec-20251231.htm, the We Power section says two unaffiliated entities own about 17% of Elm Road units 1 and 2, and We Power's share is leased to Wisconsin Electric under 30-year leases. The report does not name the LLC, so the link between We Power and the LLC is inferred from the application.

qa.question: Can the retirement year thread be closed, and what is the coal end date?
qa.finding: The October 2025 application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=566031 says in sections 5.1.3 and 7.9.6 that no property is retired and no retirements are planned, and it keeps full coal firing capability. It does not state 2030 for backup coal or 2032 for the end of coal. A search result for a We Energies wastewater permit filing mentions ending coal combustion by 31 December 2034.
qa.recommendation: Do not add a retirement year from this filing. Keep the thread open until a filing or utility statement states the coal end date for Elm Road.
qa.note: The docket also holds later filings, such as data request responses from November 2026, that I did not read.
